This notebook estimates **partial causal effects** on top of the
descriptive analyses in notebooks 01–08. It uses three complementary
identification strategies:

1. **Two-way fixed-effects panel regression** (site + trip FE) for
   rainfall / temperature / UV effects on α-diversity and CSP1-2
   abundance. Within-site weather variation is plausibly exogenous,
   so this absorbs all time-invariant site confounders (lithology,
   macroclimate, host-plant community).
2. **Double/debiased ML** for the XRF geochemistry ATEs (salinity S,
   phosphorus P, iron Fe, vanadium V) on Shannon and CSP1-2
   abundance, restricted to Trip 5 (XRF coverage).
3. **Causal mediation** (Imai et al.): tests whether the salinity →
   Shannon association flows *through* CSP1-2 abundance or operates
   in parallel. Includes Imai-style sensitivity analysis for
   unmeasured confounders on the mediator–outcome path.

```{python}
#| label: setup
import sys
from pathlib import Path
REPO = Path.cwd().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "src"))

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

from eq import CACHE_DIR, FIGURES_DIR
plt.rcParams.update({"figure.dpi": 120, "font.size": 9,
                     "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False})
np.random.seed(0)
```

## Part 0 — build the analysis frame

```{python}
#| label: build-frame
ft = pd.read_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "feature_table.parquet")
tax = pd.read_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "taxonomy.parquet")
meta = pd.read_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "metadata_with_rainfall.parquet").set_index("sample")

# relative abundance per sample
ft_rel = ft.div(ft.sum(axis=0), axis=1)

# Shannon per sample
from eq.diversity import shannon
shan = shannon(ft)   # series indexed by sample
meta["shannon"] = shan.reindex(meta.index)

# CSP1-2 relative abundance (genus-level match)
csp_asvs = tax[
    tax["Taxon"].str.contains("CSP1-2|Dadabacteria", case=False, regex=True, na=False)
].index
meta["csp_relab"] = ft_rel.loc[csp_asvs].sum(axis=0).reindex(meta.index).fillna(0)

# radiation guild rel-abund
rad = ["Rubrobacter", "Deinococcus", "Geodermatophilus",
       "Modestobacter", "Blastococcus"]
rad_asvs = tax[tax.genus.isin(rad)].index
meta["rad_relab"] = ft_rel.loc[rad_asvs].sum(axis=0).reindex(meta.index).fillna(0)

# MND1 (ammonia-ox partner) and Nitrospira
for g in ["MND1", "Nitrospira"]:
    asvs = tax[tax.genus == g].index
    meta[f"{g.lower()}_relab"] = ft_rel.loc[asvs].sum(axis=0).reindex(meta.index).fillna(0)

# Extended climate: prefer NASA POWER (bulk-friendly), fall back to Open-Meteo
np_path = CACHE_DIR / "nasa_power_daily.parquet"
om_path = CACHE_DIR / "climate_extended.parquet"
if np_path.exists():
    cx = pd.read_parquet(np_path)
    cx["Date"] = pd.to_datetime(cx["Date"])
    uv_col, rad_col, et_col, sm_col = ("ALLSKY_SFC_UV_INDEX",
                                        "ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN",
                                        "EVPTRNS", "GWETTOP")
    src = "NASA POWER"
elif om_path.exists():
    cx = pd.read_parquet(om_path)
    cx["Date"] = pd.to_datetime(cx["Date"])
    uv_col, rad_col, et_col, sm_col = ("uv_index_max",
                                        "shortwave_radiation_sum",
                                        "et0_fao_evapotranspiration",
                                        "soil_moisture_0_to_7cm")
    src = "Open-Meteo"
else:
    cx = None
    print("  no extended climate found — proceeding without UV/SM/ET0")

if cx is not None:
    meta = meta.reset_index()
    meta["trip_date"] = pd.to_datetime(meta["trip_date"])
    rows = []
    for _, r in meta.iterrows():
        s, d = r.site, r.trip_date
        subset = cx[(cx.Site == s) & (cx.Date <= d)]
        w7 = subset[subset.Date > d - pd.Timedelta(days=7)]
        w30 = subset[subset.Date > d - pd.Timedelta(days=30)]
        rows.append({
            "uv_W7d": w7[uv_col].mean(),
            "uv_W30d": w30[uv_col].mean(),
            "rad_W30d": w30[rad_col].mean(),
            "et0_W30d": w30[et_col].mean(),
            "sm_W7d": w7[sm_col].mean(),
            "sm_W30d": w30[sm_col].mean(),
        })
    clim_wide = pd.DataFrame(rows, index=meta.index)
    meta = pd.concat([meta, clim_wide], axis=1).set_index("sample")
    print(f"  merged extended climate ({src}): {clim_wide.shape[1]} new vars")

# XRF per site (Trip-5 panel)
field = pd.read_csv(
    REPO / "../code-and-data/data/processed/geochemistry/xrf_field_table.tsv",
    sep="\t"
)
xrf_site = field.groupby("SiteID")[["Fe", "Mn", "Si", "Ca", "S", "P", "V", "K"]].mean().reset_index()
xrf_site = xrf_site.rename(columns={"SiteID": "site"})
# lab XRF (has Na, Cl) — 55 rhizosphere samples, mapped by SampleID prefix to site
lab = pd.read_csv(
    REPO / "../code-and-data/data/processed/geochemistry/xrf/xrf_lab_table_filtered.tsv",
    sep="\t"
)
# SampleID format: e.g. "24Dr1" = site 24 Deep replicate 1
lab["site"] = lab["SampleID"].str.extract(r"^(\d+)").astype(int)
lab_site = lab.groupby("site")[["Na", "Cl"]].mean().reset_index()
xrf_full = xrf_site.merge(lab_site, on="site", how="left")
print(f"  XRF site table: {xrf_full.shape} (n={xrf_full.site.nunique()} sites)")

frame = meta.reset_index().merge(xrf_full, on="site", how="left")
frame["compartment_num"] = frame.compartment.map({"surface": 0, "deep": 1, "rhizosphere": 2})
frame.to_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "causal_frame_tier1.parquet")
print(f"  analysis frame: {frame.shape}")
print(f"  with XRF: {frame.dropna(subset=['S','P']).shape[0]} samples")
```

## Part A — two-way fixed-effects panel regression

Here we estimate the causal effect of antecedent rainfall and
temperature on Shannon diversity and keystone abundance **within
site, within compartment**. Site FE absorbs all time-invariant
confounders (lithology, host-plant community, aeolian history, etc.);
trip FE absorbs all common shocks across sites (seasonal waves,
large-scale climate). Implementation uses the **within transformation**
(double-demeaning by site and trip) and cluster-robust SEs by site,
via `statsmodels`.

```{python}
#| label: fe-panel
import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import statsmodels.api as sm

def within_demean(df, y_col, x_cols, entity, time):
    """Subtract site- and trip-level means (two-way within transform)."""
    df = df.copy()
    df[y_col] -= df.groupby(entity)[y_col].transform("mean")
    df[y_col] -= df.groupby(time)[y_col].transform("mean")
    df[y_col] += df[y_col].mean()  # grand-mean restore
    for x in x_cols:
        df[x] -= df.groupby(entity)[x].transform("mean")
        df[x] -= df.groupby(time)[x].transform("mean")
        df[x] += df[x].mean()
    return df

def cluster_robust_se(X, resid, cluster):
    """HC-CRVE variance estimator clustered by `cluster`."""
    n, k = X.shape
    G = cluster.nunique()
    XtX_inv = np.linalg.pinv(X.T @ X)
    u = X * resid[:, None]
    score = np.zeros((k, k))
    for g in cluster.unique():
        idx = (cluster.values == g)
        s = u[idx].sum(0, keepdims=True)
        score += s.T @ s
    vcov = XtX_inv @ score @ XtX_inv
    dof = G / (G - 1) * (n - 1) / (n - k)
    return np.sqrt(np.diag(vcov * dof))

outcomes = ["shannon", "csp_relab", "rad_relab", "mnd1_relab"]
treatments = ["rain_W7d", "rain_W14d", "rain_W30d", "temp_mean_W30d"]
if "uv_W30d" in frame.columns:
    treatments += ["uv_W30d", "sm_W30d", "et0_W30d"]

results = []
for c in ["surface", "deep", "rhizosphere"]:
    sub = frame[frame.compartment == c].copy()
    sub = sub.dropna(subset=outcomes + treatments + ["site", "trip"])
    if len(sub) < 50:
        continue
    for y in outcomes:
        for x in treatments:
            try:
                dd = within_demean(sub[[y, x, "site", "trip"]].copy(),
                                   y, [x], "site", "trip")
                X = sm.add_constant(dd[[x]].values)
                Y = dd[y].values
                beta = np.linalg.lstsq(X, Y, rcond=None)[0]
                resid = Y - X @ beta
                se = cluster_robust_se(X, resid, dd["site"])
                from scipy.stats import t as tdist
                dof = dd["site"].nunique() - 1
                tval = beta[1] / se[1]
                pval = 2 * (1 - tdist.cdf(abs(tval), df=dof))
                results.append({
                    "compartment": c, "outcome": y, "treatment": x,
                    "beta": float(beta[1]), "se": float(se[1]),
                    "t": float(tval), "p": float(pval), "n": len(sub)
                })
            except Exception as e:
                results.append({"compartment": c, "outcome": y, "treatment": x,
                                "beta": np.nan, "se": np.nan, "p": np.nan,
                                "n": len(sub), "error": str(e)[:50]})

fe_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
fe_df.to_csv(CACHE_DIR / "causal_tier1_panel_fe.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
sig = fe_df[fe_df.p < 0.05].sort_values("p").head(20)
print(f"significant effects (p < 0.05): {len(sig)} of {len(fe_df)}")
sig[["compartment", "outcome", "treatment", "beta", "se", "p"]]
```

## Part B — Double/debiased ML for XRF element ATEs

We estimate the effect of each salinity / nutrient / mineral element
on Shannon and CSP1-2 abundance, using LinearDML with gradient-boosted
trees for both nuisance regressions. Restricted to Trip 5 (XRF
coverage). Covariates: all other XRF elements + temperature + rainfall
+ lat/lon + compartment.

Implementation is the Chernozhukov et al. (2018) partialling-out DML
with 5-fold cross-fitted random forests as the outcome and treatment
nuisance learners. This is implemented in-notebook using `sklearn` so
no external DML package is required.

```{python}
#| label: double-ml
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold

def double_ml_ate(Y, T, X, seed=0, K=5):
    """Partial-out DML: residualise Y and T on X, regress resid(Y) on resid(T)."""
    n = len(Y)
    kf = KFold(n_splits=K, shuffle=True, random_state=seed)
    Y_res = np.zeros(n); T_res = np.zeros(n)
    for tr, te in kf.split(X):
        my = RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=200, min_samples_leaf=5,
                                    random_state=seed, n_jobs=-1).fit(X[tr], Y[tr])
        mt = RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=200, min_samples_leaf=5,
                                    random_state=seed, n_jobs=-1).fit(X[tr], T[tr])
        Y_res[te] = Y[te] - my.predict(X[te])
        T_res[te] = T[te] - mt.predict(X[te])
    theta = (T_res @ Y_res) / (T_res @ T_res)
    resid = Y_res - theta * T_res
    se = np.sqrt(np.mean(resid**2) / np.mean(T_res**2) / n)
    return float(theta), float(se)

tr5 = frame[frame.trip == 5].dropna(subset=["S", "P", "Fe", "V", "Cl", "Na"]).copy()
print(f"  Trip 5 with full XRF: n={len(tr5)}")

elements = ["S", "Cl", "Na", "P", "Fe", "Mn", "V", "K"]
outcomes = ["shannon", "csp_relab", "rad_relab"]

dml_rows = []
for y in outcomes:
    for e in elements:
        sub = tr5.dropna(subset=[y, e] + [x for x in elements if x != e]
                         + ["rain_W30d", "temp_mean_W30d"]).copy()
        if len(sub) < 40:
            continue
        X = sub[[x for x in elements if x != e]
                + ["rain_W30d", "temp_mean_W30d", "compartment_num"]].values
        T = sub[e].values
        Y = sub[y].values
        try:
            ate, se = double_ml_ate(Y, T, X, seed=0, K=5)
            ci_lo = ate - 1.96 * se
            ci_hi = ate + 1.96 * se
            dml_rows.append({"outcome": y, "treatment": e,
                             "ate": ate, "se": se,
                             "ci_lo": ci_lo, "ci_hi": ci_hi, "n": len(sub)})
        except Exception as err:
            dml_rows.append({"outcome": y, "treatment": e, "ate": np.nan,
                             "ci_lo": np.nan, "ci_hi": np.nan, "n": len(sub),
                             "err": str(err)[:60]})

dml_df = pd.DataFrame(dml_rows)
dml_df["significant"] = (dml_df.ci_lo * dml_df.ci_hi) > 0
dml_df.to_csv(CACHE_DIR / "causal_tier1_dml_ate.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
dml_df.sort_values("outcome").assign(
    ate=lambda d: d.ate.round(4), ci_lo=lambda d: d.ci_lo.round(4),
    ci_hi=lambda d: d.ci_hi.round(4)
)
```

## Part C — Causal mediation: salinity → CSP1-2 → Shannon

Tests whether the salinity–Shannon association flows through
suppression of the CSP1-2 keystone (indirect effect) or acts
independently (direct effect). Imai et al. (2010) framework with
nonparametric bootstrap.

```{python}
#| label: mediation
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Use Trip 5 XRF (S) for salinity treatment; CSP1-2 as mediator; Shannon as outcome
med = tr5.dropna(subset=["S", "csp_relab", "shannon", "Cl", "Na", "P",
                          "rain_W30d", "temp_mean_W30d"]).copy()

def boot_mediation(d, T, M, Y, covars, nboot=1000, seed=0):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    n = len(d)
    a_boot = []; b_boot = []; cprime_boot = []
    for _ in range(nboot):
        idx = rng.integers(0, n, n)
        db = d.iloc[idx]
        X_a = db[covars].values
        X_bT = db[covars + [T]].values
        # a: T -> M (controlling for covars)
        a = LinearRegression().fit(np.c_[X_a, db[T].values], db[M].values).coef_[-1]
        # b: M -> Y (controlling for T, covars)
        b = LinearRegression().fit(np.c_[X_bT, db[M].values], db[Y].values).coef_[-1]
        # c': T -> Y (controlling for M, covars)
        cprime = LinearRegression().fit(np.c_[X_a, db[M].values, db[T].values],
                                        db[Y].values).coef_[-1]
        a_boot.append(a); b_boot.append(b); cprime_boot.append(cprime)
    a_boot = np.array(a_boot); b_boot = np.array(b_boot); cprime_boot = np.array(cprime_boot)
    ind = a_boot * b_boot
    tot = ind + cprime_boot
    return {
        "indirect": ind.mean(), "indirect_ci": (np.quantile(ind, 0.025), np.quantile(ind, 0.975)),
        "direct": cprime_boot.mean(), "direct_ci": (np.quantile(cprime_boot, 0.025),
                                                     np.quantile(cprime_boot, 0.975)),
        "total": tot.mean(), "total_ci": (np.quantile(tot, 0.025), np.quantile(tot, 0.975)),
        "prop_mediated": (ind.mean() / tot.mean()) if tot.mean() != 0 else np.nan,
    }

covars = ["Cl", "Na", "P", "rain_W30d", "temp_mean_W30d", "compartment_num"]
out = boot_mediation(med, "S", "csp_relab", "shannon", covars, nboot=2000)
med_df = pd.DataFrame([{
    "treatment": "S", "mediator": "csp_relab", "outcome": "shannon", "n": len(med),
    "indirect_effect": out["indirect"],
    "indirect_ci": f"[{out['indirect_ci'][0]:.4f}, {out['indirect_ci'][1]:.4f}]",
    "direct_effect": out["direct"],
    "direct_ci": f"[{out['direct_ci'][0]:.4f}, {out['direct_ci'][1]:.4f}]",
    "total_effect": out["total"], "prop_mediated": out["prop_mediated"],
}])
med_df.to_csv(CACHE_DIR / "causal_tier1_mediation.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
med_df
```

### Imai-style sensitivity to unmeasured M–Y confounding

We simulate an unobserved confounder U that correlates with both
mediator and outcome at strength `rho` and report how large the
confounding would have to be to null out the indirect effect.

```{python}
#| label: mediation-sensitivity
def sens_curve(d, T, M, Y, covars, rho_grid):
    rows = []
    X = d[covars + [T]].values
    for rho in rho_grid:
        # inject rho*StdDev correlated noise into both M and Y
        rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
        u = rng.standard_normal(len(d))
        mm = d[M].values + rho * d[M].std() * u
        yy = d[Y].values + rho * d[Y].std() * u
        a = LinearRegression().fit(np.c_[X[:, :-1], d[T].values], mm).coef_[-1]
        b = LinearRegression().fit(np.c_[X, mm], yy).coef_[-1]
        rows.append({"rho": rho, "indirect_shifted": a * b})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

sens = sens_curve(med, "S", "csp_relab", "shannon", covars,
                  rho_grid=np.linspace(-0.4, 0.4, 17))
sens.to_csv(CACHE_DIR / "causal_tier1_mediation_sensitivity.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3))
ax.axhline(0, color="k", lw=0.4)
ax.plot(sens.rho, sens.indirect_shifted, "o-", color="#1f77b4")
ax.set_xlabel("Unmeasured M-Y confounder strength (ρ)")
ax.set_ylabel("Indirect effect (S → CSP1-2 → Shannon)")
ax.set_title("Mediation sensitivity analysis")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(FIGURES_DIR / "figS4_mediation_sensitivity.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```

## Part D — Tier-1 summary figure

```{python}
#| label: fig9-summary
# Panel 9A: DML ATE forest plot for Shannon outcome
dml_shan = (dml_df[dml_df.outcome == "shannon"]
            .dropna(subset=["ate"])
            .copy().reset_index(drop=True))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 3.3),
                         gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": [1, 1]})
ax = axes[0]
for i, r in dml_shan.iterrows():
    col = "#d62728" if r.significant else "#999999"
    ax.errorbar(r.ate, i, xerr=[[r.ate - r.ci_lo], [r.ci_hi - r.ate]],
                fmt="o", color="black", ecolor=col, elinewidth=2, capsize=3)
ax.axvline(0, color="k", lw=0.5)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(dml_shan))); ax.set_yticklabels(dml_shan.treatment)
ax.set_xlabel("ATE on Shannon (DML, 95% CI)")
ax.set_title("(A) Causal effects of XRF elements on α-diversity")

# Panel 9B: panel-FE rainfall coefficients
fe_shan = fe_df[(fe_df.outcome == "shannon") &
                (fe_df.treatment.str.startswith("rain_W"))].dropna(subset=["beta"])
ax = axes[1]
for i, c in enumerate(["surface", "deep", "rhizosphere"]):
    sub = fe_shan[fe_shan.compartment == c]
    ax.errorbar(sub.beta, np.arange(len(sub)) + i * 0.2 - 0.2,
                xerr=1.96 * sub.se, fmt="o",
                label=c, capsize=3)
ax.axvline(0, color="k", lw=0.5)
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(fe_shan.treatment.nunique()))
ax.set_yticklabels(fe_shan.treatment.unique())
ax.set_xlabel("β (panel FE, site+trip)")
ax.set_title("(B) Within-site rainfall effects on Shannon")
ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=7)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(FIGURES_DIR / "fig9ab_causal_tier1.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```
